signature_moments: Kinetic Hero: Line-by-line staggered text reveal using framer-motion with floating tech metrics badge
Numbered Manifesto Chapters: 01 / 02 / 03 layout with vertical industrial lines and high-contrast typography
Slow Editorial Marquee: Continuous ticker featuring ISO 9001:2015, IBR 1950, ASME, TEMA Standards and engineering keywords
Interactive Stat Counters: Smooth count-up on scroll for 12+ Years, 1,200+ Installations, 100% IBR Compliance
Hover Craft Cards: Subtle lift (-translate-y-1), crisp border accent glow, and technical spec reveal on product hover
Magnetic Action Buttons: Dual CTA buttons with subtle spring responsiveness and red-orange signal accent highlight
Floating Action Bar: Fixed bottom-right quick contact pill for WhatsApp direct chat and telephone calling

sections_to_implement.description: Sticky Navigation Header with backdrop blur, brand logo, navigation links, quick call badge, and CTA button. Includes mobile menu sheet.

Kinetic Hero section with line-by-line staggered text animation, background industrial photo with subtle dark gradient overlay, dual CTAs ('Explore Catalogue', 'Request Quote'), and live stat counters bar.
Slow moving continuous ticker strip with technical compliance standards (IBR 1950, ASME, ISO 9001:2015, TEMA, Solid Fuel, Biomass, High Pressure Thermal Systems).
Numbered Manifesto Chapters (01/ Engineering Foundation, 02/ In-House Precision, 03/ Zero-Downtime Guarantee) explaining Thermal Engitech's heritage since 2012 in Dhamatwan, Gujarat.

Interactive Bento Grid of 4 core solutions: Steam Boilers, Thermic Fluid Heaters, Heat Exchangers, Air Pre Heaters & Auxiliaries. Features technical tags, hover card effects, image previews, and detailed modal/drawer specs.
Technical Advantage section with HTRI sizing calculations, volumetric welder qualifications, precision firing controls, and lower operating costs.

Interactive grid of 14 key industries served (Chemical, Dairy, Distillery, Food, Packaging, Paper, Pharma, Plywood, Rice, Rubber, Sponge Iron, Solvent, Sugar, Textile) with active category filter/highlighting.
High-trust compliance roster displaying ISO 9001:2015, ASME, IBR 1950, and TEMA badges with full compliance details.
High-impact deep blue band for custom plant layout consultations with phone & WhatsApp direct action triggers.
Rich corporate footer with full contact info (Dhamatwan, Ahmedabad, Gujarat), office telephone (+91 70693 06431), email (info@thermalengitech.com), copyright, and quick navigation links.
Fixed bottom-right quick contact pill with direct WhatsApp chat trigger and phone call trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are implemented in JavaScript React (.jsx / .js files).
Inject fonts 'Space Grotesk' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' via Google Fonts in index.html.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, section elements, card components, and form elements.
Do NOT make the header completely transparent; use glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 with subtle bottom border border-slate-200.
Follow the generous spacing system with minimum py-16 to py-24 on major sections.
Implement smooth scrolling using CSS scroll-behavior or custom framer-motion anchors.
Ensure total responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and widescreen layouts.
Use Lucide-React icons extensively for technical metrics, badges, and bullet points.
